raw_segments.text: Ventidious. Oh, Silius, Silius, I have done enough. A lower place note well may make too
great an act. For learn this, Silius. Better to leave undone than by our deed acquire too
high a fame when him we serves away. Caesar and Antony have ever won more in their officer
than person. Sosius, one of my place in Syria, his lieutenant, for quick accumulation of
renown, which he achieved by T.H. Minnet, lost his favor.
Who does I, T.H., wars more than his captain can becomes his captain's captain. And ambition,
the soldier's virtue, rather makes choice of loss than gain which darkens him. I could do
more to do Antony as good, but would offend him, and in his offense should my performance perish.
